question: On a locally fine-tuned open-weight language model, does ordered actor/patient auxiliary training improve role answers on pairs not shown together during fine-tuning, relative to a matched unordered-identity auxiliary control?
graph: fresh0 from the sealed synthetic manifest; its 10 entity labels map to the 10 fixed names in runner.py. All 20 observed pairs are used for fine-tuning in both directions; all 25 missing pairs are test-only.

matched_training.examples: 20 observed pairs x 2 directions x 3 verbs x 2 voices x 2 queried roles = 480 identical supervised examples per trained arm
matched_training.main_task: Answer the actor or patient question with one name; identical target answer in both arms.
matched_training.auxiliary: Two 10-way heads applied to the final prompt-token state before the answer. Ordered arm targets actor and patient IDs; unordered arm targets the same two IDs sorted numerically. Both losses have weight 0.5.
matched_training.adapter: Rank-four LoRA, alpha eight, all q_proj and v_proj modules; frozen base, same head sizes and optimizer.
matched_training.optimization: One epoch, batch size one, 480 updates, AdamW learning rate 0.0001, identical initial seed and shuffled example order; no test-based checkpoint selection.

evaluation.data: All 45 pairs x 2 directions x 3 verbs x 2 voices x 2 queried roles x 2 question wordings = 2160 prompts per arm. Observed and held-out pairs reported separately; no test prompt matches a training question.
evaluation.generation: Greedy, maximum eight new tokens. Keep every raw output; exact one-name parsing after trimming terminal punctuation.
evaluation.primary_pilot_measure: Held-out-pair answer accuracy averaged equally across all 25 missing pairs, with ordered minus unordered as the comparison.
secondary: Accuracy by voice, role and wording
evaluation.no_interim_selection: Run and score all three arms on the full fixed set. Do not alter prompts, names, verbs, model, steps, or exclusions based on partial outputs.

limits: One small pretrained model, one graph, one start and constructed sentences only. The 25 pairs are absent from this fine-tuning set but may have appeared during pretraining. This pilot cannot establish robust LLM repair or internal mechanism.
